description: The figurative constant ALL literal-1 with a literal-1 longer than one character ASSOCIATED with a numeric or numeric-edited item - moved to it (the written MOVE, an implicit FROM/INTO move, INITIALIZE REPLACING's hypothetical MOVE) or compared with it (IF / EVALUATE / PERFORM UNTIL / SEARCH WHEN) - prohibited by ISO 8.3.3.6.3 SR3, which is edition-unqualified in 2023 and absent from Annex E, so 2014 agrees. DERIVED edge (VCR Table 7 row 7.13; no 1985/2002/2014 text in-repo): an obsolete element of ANSI X3.23-1985 deleted by ISO 2002 with the rest of that list - accepted at 85 with the 8.3.3.6.4 GR2 repeat-and-truncate value (ALL "57" -> PIC 9(3) = 575), 0902 at 2002+ (warning under --permissive, value preserved). One predicate: FigurativeAssociation (kb/Work PB422); askers VersionConformancePass.GateSr5 and StatementValidation.CheckRelationalOperands.
display: a multi-character ALL literal associated with a numeric or numeric-edited item
